newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korean fin minister says reforms most imperative.
newsitem.headline: S.Korean fin minister says reforms most imperative.

text.p: Finance minister Kang Kyong-shik said on Wednesday financial reform is the "most imperative" task in the spectrum of reforms to be carried out by South Korea.
"For an internationally competitive financial market, financial liberalisation is instrumental," Kang said in a speech to a meeting of the American Chamber of Commerce in Korea.
The finance ministry recently announced a range of liberalisation reforms to be implemented beginning in July.
Kang said the idea of unifying the three financial watchdog bodies under the prime minister was part of proposed "triangular architecture" to share authority and responsibility.
